_meta.title: iLaunchify UI Component Registry
_meta.purpose: Machine-readable index of @ilaunchify/ui so agents reuse components instead of inventing them. This is the FIRST thing to read before building any UI. Human spec: docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md. Enforcement: scripts/check-no-raw-tailwind-colors.mjs + scripts/check-invariants.mjs.
laws: Never hardcode a brand hex in a class — use the token class (bg-pink-500, bg-neon-500, text-pink-700). Ref: docs/DESIGN_TOKEN_HYGIENE.md.
Never use raw off-palette Tailwind families (emerald/amber/rose/sky/zinc/...) — use semantic ramps (success/warning/danger/info) + ink.
Never hand-roll a button, badge, chip, pill, card, input, dialog, or tabs — a primitive exists. Compose it.
neon-* is a DARK-SURFACE-ONLY accent. Never neon on a light surface (fails contrast).
One primary/neon button per screen section.
Header color is the audience signal: WHITE header = creator surface, BLACK header = partner surface. Never mix.

Admin list pages follow the LOCKED v2 surface (hero band + 5 KPIs + URL chips + plain sortable table + RowActionsMenu). Use the v2-admin-surface-builder subagent. No shadcn/ui Card, no @ilaunchify/ui Card.
Components map to platform OBJECTS at a size (list/card/detail), not to screens. Read docs/OOUX_OBJECT_MAP.md before adding a new object view.
_meta.how_to_extend: Add an entry under `primitives` or `components` mirroring the schema below. Keep it truthful to the source JSDoc — the source files already document variants + NEVER rules. Update `generated` date.

primitives.name: Button
primitives.use_when: Any clickable action — submit, navigate, CTA.
never: neon variant on a light surface (1.3:1 contrast)
two primary/neon buttons in one section
primitives.variant_guide: primary=black pill on light · neon=green pill on DARK only · pink=rare brand action · secondary=white pill+border · outline=over tinted/cream · ghost=tertiary

primitives.name: Badge
primitives.intent: Small pill for status / category labels. 11px / 600 weight.
primitives.use_when: Labeling an object's status or category inline.
never: neon variant on light bg (dark surfaces only, pairs with bg-ink-900)

primitives.name: Chip
primitives.intent: Interactive filter chip with active state. Active = pink-500 fill.
primitives.use_when: Marketplace filter bars, cert filter rails, any URL-driven filter row.
never: Using it as a static label (that's Badge)

primitives.name: Card / CardHeader / CardTitle
never: On admin LIST pages — the locked v2 surface forbids Card; use the hero band + plain table instead

primitives.name: Input
primitives.intent: Single-line text field. Token-styled (border/bg/focus ring via --input-*).

primitives.name: Select
primitives.intent: Choose one option from a set. Built on Radix Select.
primitives.use_when: Single choice from a defined list.

primitives.name: Dialog
primitives.intent: Modal dialog. Built on Radix Dialog.
primitives.use_when: Focused confirm/edit that shouldn't lose page context.
never: Long editing sessions (use a page/drawer instead)

primitives.name: Tabs
primitives.intent: Section switcher — black underline on active, ink-600 inactive. Built on Radix Tabs.
primitives.use_when: Deep-spec sections on detail pages, admin queues.

primitives.name: Label
primitives.intent: Accessible field label. Built on Radix Label.

primitives.name: RowActionsMenu
primitives.intent: 3-dot per-row action menu. Actions DEEP-LINK to detail pages, never inline-mutate.
primitives.use_when: Final column of any list/table row.
never: Inline mutations from the menu — link to the detail page that owns the action

components.name: ProductCard
components.intent: Marketplace card for a ProductTemplate. 1:1 image area (status + verify + emoji + heart + pastel gradient) then title, cert chips, footer (MIN UNITS · LEAD TIME · PRICE).
never: an Inquire/CTA button — the whole card is clickable; price replaces the CTA

components.name: StatusPill
components.intent: Status pill overlaid top-left of a ProductCard image (Bestseller/New/Fast ship/Low MOQ/Top rated/Popular).

components.name: HeroBanner
components.intent: Dark slab with pink radial glow + Bricolage headline + Fraunces italic emphasis (neon) + optional eyebrow + optional right-anchored graphic. Caller passes the CTA via children.

components.name: MetricCard
components.intent: KPI card — label, big tabular value, optional trend delta. The dashboard KPI-strip building block (replaces ad-hoc KpiWidget variants).
components.note: Admin surfaces also have apps/admin/src/components/widgets/KpiWidget.tsx for the locked v2 strip.

components.intent: Public partner profile body (Front Face) — dark hero (230px cover; logo straddles the banner with services + name + inline tier badge beside it on the black, tagline + location below), 5-cell stat strip, tabs (Overview/Capabilities/Merit/Certs/Reviews), right rail. Tier badge shows attainment ONLY (Verified/Trusted/Premier) — never the partner-charged fee. Optional `canShare` renders a Share popover (signed-in PAID creators only). Shared by marketing /partners/[slug] and the partner app /profile preview. See docs/PUBLIC_PARTNER_PROFILE_SPEC_2026-07-14.md.
components.use_when: Rendering a partner's public Front Face from the @ilaunchify/db getPartnerProfile reader. Pass canShare only for paid viewers.
components.never: Don't fabricate profile data. NEVER show the fee a partner is charged, product SKUs/prices, or named client reviews to non-paid viewers (reader masks these). Don't render for partners without FULL disclosure — the reader gates.
components.name: PartnerFrontFace

catalog_pointers.note: ~55 object-view components live in packages/ui/src/components/. Not all are hand-documented here yet — check the source JSDoc before building a new one; most are self-documented. High-frequency ones by domain:

admin_list_page.recipe: hero band (bg-[var(--bg-hero)], rounded-3xl) → 5-card KPI strip → URL-driven Chip filter rows → plain sortable <table> → RowActionsMenu final column → prev/next paginator @ 50/page

creator_surface.recipe: WHITE header (pink logo) → HeroBanner or content → black-pill primary CTA. Comfortable density (24px card padding).

partner_surface.recipe: BLACK header (pink logo, neon 'Business' wordmark) → neon-green pill CTA (inverse of creator). Compact density (16px), dark-mode default.

partner_editor_card.recipe: autosave + FSM transition + AuditLog write + approval-marked. Use the partner-editor-card-builder subagent.
